title: Fact check: Trump says food and gas prices are down
summary: PolitiFact check of Trump's cabinet-meeting claim that groceries and energy are down: eggs, bread and fuels fell but electricity, ground beef and bacon rose, rated half true.

verdicts.note: BLS data showed eggs and bread down but ground beef, bacon and overall food at home up during 2025.

The CPI food index rose 2.5% from January to December 2025 (335.517 to 343.795) and was up 3.1% year over year in December 2025; the series covers all food including restaurants rather than groceries alone.

assertions.quote: It was $4 and $5 for a gallon of gas. Think of that for ga gasoline. And now it's probably 225.

verdicts.note: 2025 gasoline averaged about $3.10-3.20, below the 2022-24 averages but far above $2.25; the $4-5 figure was the mid-2022 peak.

Regular gasoline averaged 3.101 over Feb-Dec 2025 (range 2.894-3.171), 10.4% below the Biden-period mean of 3.461 and 37% below the Biden peak of 4.929, with every 2025 month under the Biden mean; the caveat is that 2025 was essentially flat against the final Biden months (Oct 2024-Jan 2025: 3.137, 3.053, 3.018, 3.076), so the gap is against the Biden average, not the handover price.
Gasoline and other fuels fell in 2025 but electricity prices rose about 5%.

The energy index was below its year-earlier level from February through July 2025 (-0.2% to -3.7%) but turned positive from August, ending 2025 at 274.131, 0.4% above January 2025 (273.045) and 2.3% above December 2024; down for much of the year, not down overall by year end.

Fuel prices in 2025 were flat to down: WTI fell from 75.74 (Jan 2025) to 57.97 (Dec 2025, -23%), regular gasoline eased from 3.076 to 2.894 (-6%) and diesel was flat (3.634 to 3.615); electricity and natural gas, part of overall energy prices, are outside these series.

assertions.quote: if we look at electricity by itself, those prices are up

verdicts.note: Retail electricity rose roughly 5-6% in 2025 on data-center demand and grid costs.
The fuel half holds for 2025: WTI fell 23% from Jan to Dec 2025 (75.74 to 57.97) and regular gasoline slipped from 3.076 to 2.894; the electricity half is outside these series.

assertions.quote: the costs of things like ground beef and bacon, which are up more than 10%

verdicts.note: Ground beef hit record highs in 2025 on the smallest US cattle herd in decades.
